title: Naples jetski rental
specs: We look forward to welcoming you! 🌞 ⸻ 📝 Before You Arrive All waivers and Boater Safety requirements must be completed prior to arrival.
Please inspect your ski before departure — it must be returned in the same condition received.
Insurance must be purchased individually for each ski rented.
A photo ID is required while on the water.
2-Hour Adventure Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Take a refreshing break at Keewaydin Beach for a swim, enjoy treats from the floating food boat, or treat yourself to delicious ice cream to cool off, all while having plenty of time for free play!
Private 3-Hour Ultimate Adventure Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.

Cruise at your own pace, soak in the stunning views, and create memories that will last a lifetime! 💦 Book your jet ski rental now and get ready for an incredible day on the water! 🏝️ More info Must be at least 18 years of age to rent a personal watercraft.
Must be at least 16 years of age to operate a pwc.

services.name: Freedom Rentals (Self Guided)
services.desc: Self-guided jet ski rentals with extensive riding area near Keewaydin Island and multiple hourly options. 🌊 Freedom Rentals – 2 or 3 Hours age 25+

services.name: Private 3-Hour Ultimate Adventure Tour
services.desc: 🌴 3-Hour Ultimate Adventure Ages 18+ • 3 Hours • Book Now

services.name: 2-Hour Adventure Tour
services.desc: Cruise Rookery Bay and Keewaydin Beach on a private guided jet ski adventure. Your group only—no strangers. 2 jet ski minimum. Ages 18+ • 2 Hours • Book Now

services.name: 🚣 Kayak Adventures
services.desc: 🚣‍♂️ Dive into the pristine waters of Naples and Marco Island with our kayak rentals! Explore designated trails or embark on island hopping adventures to Johnson 🏝️, Umbrella 🏖️, Sea Oat 🌾, and Keewaydin 🏝️ islands. Encounter charming hut houses, a vibrant dolphin community 🐬, and picturesque wildlife on your thrilling kayaking All ages • 1 - 8 Hours • Start your adventure today! 🌊
